Deep field images give us our furthest peeks into the universe. The bright light at the center is a galaxy cluster over 4.5 billion light-years away.

The cluster, Abell S1063, is an incredibly massive cluster of multiple galaxies. So massive, that its gravity is able to bend light. (2/3)
